scope: Finite documented replay and source identity checks.

output.method: Finite independent SHA-256 compression replay; same plain-JavaScript arithmetic as replay_resolve31.cjs, not a project solver or encoder. All 61 source rows are examined and deduplicated by rounds, common CV and unordered messages.
limits: Finite witnesses, not a success-probability or work-factor proof.
Table tail estimates and sigma-class fields are copied as historical metadata, not re-estimated or certified.
Chosen-CV compression collisions are not ordinary standard-IV hashes.
One-step controls concern only these same messages and chaining values.
Comparison to the existing 85 uses numeric identities, not filenames.
